title: Flat right-angle border
description: Change your original GUI interface from a semicircular (arc-shaped) design to a right-angle design, similar to a flat design.
body:
A simple GUI texture pack that slightly modifies some details based on the original, giving the overall style a flat UI look with sharp edges.
![Backpack Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/773b004324cc84bc61a45a52a0d088d3a0c7b9c9.png)![Trading Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d128f6f365e08af1785b07ee7a12692ae6706e.png)![Creative Mode Inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dfba9cd151da7c70b539dcffc18ea0fed4f912e.png)![Achievement](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b41419fe5bfc573f3096517d2faec1b426d7e24.png)![Box interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63e97268c86f414d664f9179fb09d46d9dfd0fb0.png)![Forge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b07539859434532b3cfc61b8fe0c482d7e8de25c.png)![Furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51b95d284866877c52a52fee43c6ead74d0343f8.png)![Workbench](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f1518424ab87ae49d4830d284aeca94bc7df23c.png)
Note: English is not my native language, so I apologize for any grammatical errors.
